title: No Gods of Silver or Gold
kjv_text: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
summary: Restates the image ban with specificity: no manufacturing deities from precious metals, even as companions ('with me') to YHWH's worship.
original_audience: Israel via Moses, immediately after the Decalogue's public delivery; the golden calf (Ex 32) will violate it exactly.
immediate_context: Opens the 'Book of the Covenant' (Ex 20:22-23:33), the oldest law collection in the Bible; bridges the Decalogue to the altar law.
historical_context: Precious-metal cult statues were temple treasury and god at once; melting the calf and making Israel drink it (Ex 32:20) follows an attested ANE pattern for annihilating a god. The 'with me' clause targets syncretism — adding gods alongside, not just replacing.
penalty: None stated; the calf episode answers with plague and sword (Ex 32:27-28,35).
exceptions: The tabernacle is nonetheless furnished with gold cherubim and gold everything (Ex 25) — sanctioned images in the sanctuary the law protects.
nt_passages: Acts 17:29 — the Godhead is not like gold or silver
1 Peter 1:18 — redeemed not with silver and gold
Revelation 9:20 — idols of gold as end-times furniture

internal_contradictions.issue: Who gave the law to Moses? God directly (here), vs. angels (Gal 3:19, Acts 7:53, Heb 2:2).

usofc_implementation: Implemented as the Precious Metals Devotional Use Act: bullion ownership above a threshold requires an OIP affidavit that the metal is 'inert' (non-devotional). Gold religious statuary is contraband; gold on state regalia is 'ornament, not god.' The statute's real function is asset surveillance wearing a mitre.
constitutional_analogue: Free exercise casualty like the image ban; its asset-registry mechanics echo Executive Order 6102's gold confiscation, re-theologized.
scene_ideas: An OIP audit of a jeweler's back room: which crucifixes are 'ornament' and which are 'god' turns on the invoice wording.
A survivalist's gold coins seized as 'potential deities in specie.'
satirical_uses: The Federal Reserve of Christ keeps the national gold in a vault nicknamed, by everyone, the Calf.
